236	    # -- detection --------------------------------------------------------
237	    def detect(self, data: bytes, target_branch: int,
238	               fast: Optional[bool] = None) -> MutationMask:
239	        """Return the :class:`MutationMask` for ``(data, target_branch)``."""
240	        key = self.cache_key(data, target_branch)
241	        cached = self.cache.get(key)
242	        if cached is not None:
243	            self.cache_hits += 1
244	            return cached
245	        self.cache_misses += 1
246	
247	        length = len(data)
248	        # The branch has to be hit in the first place, otherwise there is
249	        # nothing to preserve and every byte is safe.
250	        base_edges = self.runner(bytes(data))
251	        self.probe_execs += 1
252	        if target_branch not in base_edges:
253	            mask = MutationMask.all_safe(length, target_branch, hits_target=False)
254	            self.cache[key] = mask
255	            return mask
256	
257	        probed = min(length, self.max_len)
258	        before = self.probe_execs
259	        scores = {pos: self.probe_position(bytes(data), pos, target_branch, fast)
260	                  for pos in range(probed)}
261	        mask = MutationMask.from_scores(length, scores, self.threshold,
262	                                        target_branch,
263	                                        probes_used=self.probe_execs - before)
264	        self.cache[key] = mask
265	        return mask
266	
267	    def detect_fast(self, data: bytes, target_branch: int) -> MutationMask:
268	        """Explicit fast (early-terminating) variant."""
269	        return self.detect(data, target_branch, fast=True)

272	class MaskedHavocMutator:
273	    """AFL's havoc operators restricted to the safe positions of a mask.
274	
275	    In-place operators (bit flip, interesting value, arithmetic, random byte,
276	    block overwrite) are only applied when the whole written span is safe.
277	    Length-changing operators (delete / clone) are allowed only in the tail
278	    region past the last influential byte, so influential bytes never move.
279	    """
280	
281	    def __init__(self, rng: np.random.RandomState,
282	                 extras: Optional[Sequence[bytes]] = None,
283	                 stack_pow2: int = HAVOC_STACK_POW2):
284	        self.rng = rng
285	        self.extras: List[bytes] = list(extras or [])
286	        self.stack_pow2 = stack_pow2
287	        self.applied_ops = 0
288	        self.skipped_ops = 0
289	
290	    # -- helpers ----------------------------------------------------------
291	    def _rand_below(self, limit: int) -> int:
292	        if limit <= 1:
293	            return 0
294	        return int(self.rng.randint(0, limit))
295	
296	    def _pick_safe(self, mask: MutationMask, width: int,
297	                   buf_len: int) -> Optional[int]:
298	        """Uniformly pick a start offset whose whole ``width`` span is safe."""
299	        options: List[int] = []
300	        for run_start, run_len in mask.safe_runs():
301	            last = min(run_start + run_len, buf_len) - width
302	            options.extend(range(run_start, last + 1))
303	        if not options:
304	            return None
305	        return options[self._rand_below(len(options))]
306	
307	    # -- mutation ---------------------------------------------------------
308	    def mutate(self, data: bytes, mask: MutationMask,
309	               stack_pow: Optional[int] = None) -> bytes:
310	        """Apply a stack of masked havoc operations to ``data``."""
311	        buf = bytearray(data) or bytearray(b"\x00")
312	        if stack_pow is None:
313	            stack_pow = 1 + self._rand_below(self.stack_pow2)
314	        n_ops = 12 if self.extras else 11
315	
316	        for _ in range(1 << stack_pow):
317	            op = self._rand_below(n_ops)
318	            if not self._apply_op(op, buf, mask):
319	                self.skipped_ops += 1
320	            else:
321	                self.applied_ops += 1
322	        return bytes(buf) if buf else b"\x00"
323	
324	    def _apply_op(self, op: int, buf: bytearray, mask: MutationMask) -> bool:
325	        """Apply one havoc operator; return False if the mask blocked it."""
326	        if op == 0:  # flip a random bit of a safe byte
327	            pos = self._pick_safe(mask, 1, len(buf))
328	            if pos is None:
329	                return False
330	            buf[pos] ^= 1 << self._rand_below(8)
331	        elif op == 1:  # interesting byte
332	            pos = self._pick_safe(mask, 1, len(buf))
333	            if pos is None:
334	                return False
335	            buf[pos] = mutation_ops.INTERESTING_8[
336	                self._rand_below(len(mutation_ops.INTERESTING_8))] & 0xFF
337	        elif op == 2:  # interesting word
338	            pos = self._pick_safe(mask, 2, len(buf))
339	            if pos is None:
340	                return False
341	            _wr16(buf, pos, mutation_ops.INTERESTING_16[
342	                self._rand_below(len(mutation_ops.INTERESTING_16))],
343	                big=bool(self._rand_below(2)))
344	        elif op == 3:  # interesting dword
345	            pos = self._pick_safe(mask, 4, len(buf))
346	            if pos is None:
347	                return False
348	            _wr32(buf, pos, mutation_ops.INTERESTING_32[
349	                self._rand_below(len(mutation_ops.INTERESTING_32))],
350	                big=bool(self._rand_below(2)))
351	        elif op in (4, 5):  # byte arithmetic
352	            pos = self._pick_safe(mask, 1, len(buf))
353	            if pos is None:
354	                return False
355	            delta = 1 + self._rand_below(ARITH_MAX)
356	            buf[pos] = ((buf[pos] + delta) if op == 5 else (buf[pos] - delta)) & 0xFF
357	        elif op in (6, 7):  # word arithmetic
358	            pos = self._pick_safe(mask, 2, len(buf))
359	            if pos is None:
360	                return False
361	            big = bool(self._rand_below(2))
362	            delta = 1 + self._rand_below(ARITH_MAX)
363	            val = _rd16(buf, pos, big)
364	            _wr16(buf, pos, (val + delta) if op == 7 else (val - delta), big)
365	        elif op == 8:  # randomise a safe byte
366	            pos = self._pick_safe(mask, 1, len(buf))
367	            if pos is None:
368	                return False
369	            buf[pos] ^= 1 + self._rand_below(255)
370	        elif op == 9:  # overwrite a run of safe bytes with a constant
371	            runs = [r for r in mask.safe_runs() if r[1] >= 2 and r[0] + r[1] <= len(buf)]
372	            if not runs:
373	                return False
374	            start, run_len = runs[self._rand_below(len(runs))]
375	            copy_len = 1 + self._rand_below(run_len)
376	            pos = start + self._rand_below(run_len - copy_len + 1)
377	            buf[pos:pos + copy_len] = bytes([self._rand_below(256)] * copy_len)
378	        elif op == 10:  # tail-only length change (never shifts influential bytes)
379	            return self._tail_resize(buf, mask)
380	        elif op == 11 and self.extras:  # dictionary token over a safe span
381	            token = self.extras[self._rand_below(len(self.extras))]
382	            pos = self._pick_safe(mask, len(token), len(buf))
383	            if pos is None:
384	                return False
385	            buf[pos:pos + len(token)] = token
386	        else:
387	            return False
388	        return True
389	
390	    def _tail_resize(self, buf: bytearray, mask: MutationMask) -> bool:
391	        """Insert or delete bytes strictly after the last influential byte."""
392	        tail = mask.tail_start()
393	        if tail > len(buf):
394	            return False
395	        if self._rand_below(2) and len(buf) > tail:  # delete from the tail
396	            del_len = 1 + self._rand_below(len(buf) - tail)
397	            del_from = tail + self._rand_below(len(buf) - tail - del_len + 1)
398	            del buf[del_from:del_from + del_len]
399	            return True
400	        if len(buf) >= 4096:
401	            return False
402	        ins_len = 1 + self._rand_below(8)
403	        pos = tail + self._rand_below(len(buf) - tail + 1)
404	        buf[pos:pos] = bytes([self._rand_below(256) for _ in range(ins_len)])
405	        return True

408	class FairFuzzFuzzer(AFLFuzzer):
409	    """AFL extended with FairFuzz's rare-branch targeted mutation.
410	
411	    Per queue entry the fuzzer
412	
413	    1. asks the :class:`~fuzzsim.fairfuzz_rare.RareBranchTracker` for a rare
414	       branch the entry hits (:meth:`select_target_branch`),
415	    2. asks the :class:`InfluenceDetector` which bytes keep that branch hit,
416	    3. replaces AFL's havoc stage with masked havoc over the safe bytes.
417	
418	    Every execution (including probes) feeds the tracker, and every calibrated
419	    queue entry updates the per-corpus edge frequencies.
420	    """
421	
422	    def __init__(self, *args: Any,
423	                 probes: int = NUM_PROBES,
424	                 influence_threshold: float = INFLUENCE_THRESHOLD,
425	                 rarity_mode: str = "fixed",
426	                 rarity_cutoff: int = RARE_CUTOFF_FIXED,
427	                 fast_influence: bool = True,
428	                 weighted_targeting: bool = False,
429	                 **kwargs: Any):
430	        self.rare_tracker = RareBranchTracker(mode=rarity_mode,
431	                                              cutoff=rarity_cutoff)
432	        self.weighted_targeting = weighted_targeting
433	        self.targeted_stages = 0
434	        self.untargeted_stages = 0
435	        self.masked_execs = 0
436	        self.branch_preserved = 0
437	        self.target_branch_history: List[Tuple[int, int]] = []
438	
439	        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
440	
441	        # The instrumented branch universe is known statically; branches no
442	        # input ever reaches are the rarest ones and must be reportable.
443	        program = getattr(self.target, "program", None)
444	        if program is not None and getattr(program, "edges", None):
445	            self.rare_tracker.register_edges(e.edge_id for e in program.edges)
446	
447	        self.detector = InfluenceDetector(runner=self._probe_runner,
448	                                          rng=np.random.RandomState(self.seed + 1),
449	                                          probes=probes,
450	                                          threshold=influence_threshold,
451	                                          fast=fast_influence)
452	        self.masked_mutator = MaskedHavocMutator(self.rng,
453	                                                 self.dictionary.all_extras())
454	
455	    # -- plumbing ---------------------------------------------------------
456	    def _probe_runner(self, data: bytes) -> Set[int]:
457	        """Execution hook handed to the detector (counts against the budget)."""
458	        return self.run_target(data).edges
459	
460	    def run_target(self, data: bytes) -> ExecResult:
461	        """Run the target and feed the observed branches to the tracker."""
462	        res = super().run_target(data)
463	        self.rare_tracker.record_input(res.edges)
464	        return res
465	
466	    def add_to_queue(self, data: bytes, depth: int = 0,
467	                     parent: Optional[int] = None,
468	                     calibrate: bool = True) -> QueueEntry:
469	        """Queue an entry and update the per-corpus edge frequencies."""
470	        entry = super().add_to_queue(data, depth=depth, parent=parent,
471	                                     calibrate=calibrate)
472	        self.rare_tracker.add_seed(entry.coverage)
473	        return entry
474	
475	    # -- FairFuzz stages --------------------------------------------------
476	    def select_target_branch(self, entry: QueueEntry) -> Optional[int]:
477	        """Rare branch this entry should preserve during targeted havoc."""
478	        return self.rare_tracker.select_target_branch(
479	            entry.coverage, rng=self.rng, weighted=self.weighted_targeting)
480	
481	    def compute_mask(self, entry: QueueEntry, target_branch: int) -> MutationMask:
482	        """Influence mask for ``entry`` w.r.t. ``target_branch`` (cached)."""
483	        return self.detector.detect(entry.data, target_branch)
484	
485	    def masked_havoc(self, data: bytes, mask: MutationMask) -> bytes:
486	        return self.masked_mutator.mutate(data, mask)
487	
488	    def havoc_stage(self, entry: QueueEntry, perf_score: float,
489	                    doing_det: bool) -> int:
490	        """Targeted (mask-constrained) havoc, falling back to AFL's havoc."""
491	        target = self.select_target_branch(entry)
492	        if target is None:
493	            self.untargeted_stages += 1
494	            return super().havoc_stage(entry, perf_score, doing_det)
495	
496	        mask = self.compute_mask(entry, target)
497	        if not mask.hits_target:  # nothing to preserve -> plain havoc
498	            self.untargeted_stages += 1
499	            return super().havoc_stage(entry, perf_score, doing_det)
500	
501	        self._stage("targeted havoc")
502	        self.targeted_stages += 1
503	        self.target_branch_history.append((self.total_execs, target))
504	        cycles = HAVOC_CYCLES if doing_det else HAVOC_CYCLES_INIT
505	        stage_max = max(HAVOC_MIN, int(cycles * perf_score / 100.0))
506	
507	        found = 0
508	        for _ in range(stage_max):
509	            candidate = self.masked_havoc(entry.data, mask)
510	            res = self.run_target(candidate)
511	            self.masked_execs += 1
512	            if target in res.edges:
513	                self.branch_preserved += 1
514	            found += self.save_if_interesting(candidate, res, entry)
515	        return found
516	
517	    # -- reporting --------------------------------------------------------
518	    def preservation_rate(self) -> float:
519	        """Fraction of masked mutants that still hit their target branch."""
520	        if not self.masked_execs:
521	            return 0.0
522	        return self.branch_preserved / self.masked_execs * 100.0
523	
524	    def stats(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
525	        stats = super().stats()
526	        stats.update({
527	            "rare_branches": len(self.rare_tracker.get_rare_branches()),
528	            "rare_branch_ids": sorted(self.rare_tracker.get_rare_branches()),
529	            "rarity_threshold": self.rare_tracker.threshold(),
530	            "targeted_stages": self.targeted_stages,
531	            "untargeted_stages": self.untargeted_stages,
532	            "masked_execs": self.masked_execs,
533	            "preservation_rate": self.preservation_rate(),
534	            "mask_cache": self.detector.cache_stats(),
535	            "tracker": self.rare_tracker.statistics(),
536	        })
537	        return stats

10	# Interesting values for different sizes (from AFL)
11	INTERESTING_8 = [-128, -1, 0, 1, 16, 32, 64, 100, 127]
12	INTERESTING_16 = [-32768, -129, 128, 255, 256, 512, 1000, 1024, 4096, 32767]
13	INTERESTING_32 = [-2147483648, -100663046, -32769, 32768, 65535, 65536,
14	                  100663045, 2147483647]

17	def bit_flip(data: bytes, pos: int, width: int = 1) -> bytes:
18	    """Flip 'width' consecutive bits starting at bit position 'pos'."""
19	    buf = bytearray(data)
20	    for i in range(width):
21	        bit_pos = pos + i
22	        byte_idx = bit_pos // 8
23	        bit_idx = bit_pos % 8
24	        if byte_idx < len(buf):
25	            buf[byte_idx] ^= (1 << (7 - bit_idx))
26	    return bytes(buf)
27	
28	
29	def byte_flip(data: bytes, pos: int, width: int = 1) -> bytes:
30	    """Flip 'width' consecutive bytes starting at position 'pos'."""
31	    buf = bytearray(data)
32	    for i in range(width):
33	        if pos + i < len(buf):
34	            buf[pos + i] ^= 0xFF
35	    return bytes(buf)
36	
37	
38	def arith_add(data: bytes, pos: int, value: int = 1) -> bytes:
39	    """Add a small value to byte at position 'pos'."""
40	    buf = bytearray(data)
41	    if pos < len(buf):
42	        buf[pos] = (buf[pos] + value) & 0xFF
43	    return bytes(buf)

45	
46	def arith_sub(data: bytes, pos: int, value: int = 1) -> bytes:
47	    """Subtract a small value from byte at position 'pos'."""
48	    buf = bytearray(data)
49	    if pos < len(buf):
50	        buf[pos] = (buf[pos] - value) & 0xFF
51	    return bytes(buf)

54	def interesting_values(data: bytes, pos: int, rng: np.random.RandomState) -> bytes:
55	    """Replace byte at position with an interesting value."""
56	    buf = bytearray(data)
57	    if pos < len(buf):
58	        val = INTERESTING_8[rng.randint(0, len(INTERESTING_8))]
59	        buf[pos] = val & 0xFF
60	    return bytes(buf)

63	def random_byte(data: bytes, pos: int, rng: np.random.RandomState) -> bytes:
64	    """Replace byte at position with a random value."""
65	    buf = bytearray(data)
66	    if pos < len(buf):
67	        buf[pos] = rng.randint(0, 256)
68	    return bytes(buf)

71	def clone_bytes(data: bytes, src: int, dst: int, length: int) -> bytes:
72	    """Clone a chunk of bytes from src to dst position."""
73	    buf = bytearray(data)
74	    if src + length <= len(buf) and dst + length <= len(buf):
75	        chunk = buf[src:src + length]
76	        buf[dst:dst + length] = chunk
77	    return bytes(buf)

80	def delete_bytes(data: bytes, pos: int, length: int) -> bytes:
81	    """Delete 'length' bytes starting at position 'pos'."""
82	    buf = bytearray(data)
83	    if pos < len(buf):
84	        end = min(pos + length, len(buf))
85	        del buf[pos:end]
86	    if len(buf) == 0:
87	        buf = bytearray(b'\x00')
88	    return bytes(buf)

91	def insert_bytes(data: bytes, pos: int, new_bytes: bytes) -> bytes:
92	    """Insert new bytes at position 'pos'."""
93	    buf = bytearray(data)
94	    if pos <= len(buf):
95	        for i, b in enumerate(new_bytes):
96	            buf.insert(pos + i, b)
97	    return bytes(buf)

100	def havoc(data: bytes, rng: np.random.RandomState, num_mutations: int = 0) -> bytes:
101	    """Apply a random combination of mutations (AFL's havoc stage).
102	
103	    If num_mutations is 0, randomly choose 1-7 mutations to stack.
104	    """
105	    if num_mutations == 0:
106	        num_mutations = rng.randint(1, 8)
107	
108	    result = data
109	    for _ in range(num_mutations):
110	        if len(result) == 0:
111	            result = b'\x00'
112	
113	        op = rng.randint(0, 8)
114	        pos = rng.randint(0, max(1, len(result)))
115	
116	        if op == 0:
117	            # bit flip
118	            bit_pos = rng.randint(0, max(1, len(result) * 8))
119	            result = bit_flip(result, bit_pos)
120	        elif op == 1:
121	            # byte flip
122	            result = byte_flip(result, pos)
123	        elif op == 2:
124	            # arith add
125	            val = rng.randint(1, 36)
126	            result = arith_add(result, pos, val)
127	        elif op == 3:
128	            # arith sub
129	            val = rng.randint(1, 36)
130	            result = arith_sub(result, pos, val)
131	        elif op == 4:
132	            # interesting values
133	            result = interesting_values(result, pos, rng)
134	        elif op == 5:
135	            # random byte
136	            result = random_byte(result, pos, rng)
137	        elif op == 6:
138	            # delete bytes (only if input > 4 bytes)
139	            if len(result) > 4:
140	                length = rng.randint(1, min(4, len(result) - 1))
141	                result = delete_bytes(result, pos, length)
142	        elif op == 7:
143	            # insert random bytes
144	            length = rng.randint(1, 5)
145	            new_data = bytes(rng.randint(0, 256, size=length).astype(np.uint8))
146	            insert_pos = rng.randint(0, max(1, len(result)))
147	            result = insert_bytes(result, insert_pos, new_data)
148	
149	    return result

152	def splice(data1: bytes, data2: bytes, rng: np.random.RandomState) -> bytes:
153	    """Splice two test cases at a random midpoint (AFL's splice stage)."""
154	    if len(data1) < 2 or len(data2) < 2:
155	        return data1
156	
157	    min_len = min(len(data1), len(data2))
158	    split_pos = rng.randint(1, min_len)
159	
160	    return data1[:split_pos] + data2[split_pos:min(len(data2), len(data1))]

114	    are needed to trigger certain paths.

122	    def execute(self, input_data: bytes) -> Tuple[Set[int], bool, float]:
123	        """Execute crashme with input-dependent path selection.
124	
125	        Path selection logic:
126	        - Byte 0: selects initial branch (mod 3)
127	        - Byte 1: selects second-level branch (mod 2)
128	        - Byte 2+: selects deeper branches with specific conditions
129	
130	        Crash path 1: byte[0]%3==2, byte[1]%2==0, byte[2] in [0x30..0x3F],
131	                       byte[3] in [0x80..0x9F]
132	          -> blocks 0,3,8,17,19 (crash edge 25)
133	        Crash path 2: byte[0]%3==2, byte[1]%2==1, byte[2]==0x4D,
134	                       byte[3]==0x5A, byte[4]%4==3
135	          -> blocks 0,3,9,18,17,19 (crash edge 25 via rare 26)
136	        """
137	        edges_hit = set()
138	        is_crash = False
139	        exec_time = 0.001  # base cost
140	
141	        if len(input_data) == 0:
142	            return edges_hit, False, exec_time
143	
144	        # Level 1: entry -> {1, 2, 3}
145	        b0 = input_data[0] if len(input_data) > 0 else 0
146	        branch1 = b0 % 3
147	
148	        if branch1 == 0:
149	            edges_hit.add(0)  # 0->1
150	            current = 1
151	        elif branch1 == 1:
152	            edges_hit.add(1)  # 0->2
153	            current = 2
154	        else:
155	            edges_hit.add(2)  # 0->3
156	            current = 3
157	
158	        exec_time += 0.001
159	
160	        # Level 2
161	        b1 = input_data[1] if len(input_data) > 1 else 0
162	        branch2 = b1 % 2
163	
164	        if current == 1:
165	            if branch2 == 0:
166	                edges_hit.add(3)  # 1->4
167	                current = 4
168	            else:
169	                edges_hit.add(4)  # 1->5
170	                current = 5
171	        elif current == 2:
172	            if branch2 == 0:
173	                edges_hit.add(5)  # 2->6
174	                current = 6
175	            else:
176	                edges_hit.add(6)  # 2->7
177	                current = 7
178	        elif current == 3:
179	            if branch2 == 0:
180	                edges_hit.add(7)  # 3->8
181	                current = 8
182	            else:
183	                edges_hit.add(8)  # 3->9
184	                current = 9
185	
186	        exec_time += 0.001
187	
188	        # Level 3

190	        b3 = input_data[3] if len(input_data) > 3 else 0
191	        b4 = input_data[4] if len(input_data) > 4 else 0
192	        b5 = input_data[5] if len(input_data) > 5 else 0
193	
194	        if current == 4:
195	            if b2 % 2 == 0:
196	                edges_hit.add(9)   # 4->10
197	                edges_hit.add(18)  # 10->19
198	            else:
199	                edges_hit.add(10)  # 4->11
200	                edges_hit.add(19)  # 11->19
201	        elif current == 5:
202	            edges_hit.add(11)  # 5->12
203	            # Loop: if byte[3] is high, take back edge
204	            if b3 > 200:
205	                edges_hit.add(27)  # 5->4 back edge
206	                edges_hit.add(9)   # 4->10
207	                edges_hit.add(18)  # 10->19
208	            else:
209	                edges_hit.add(20)  # 12->19
210	        elif current == 6:
211	            if b2 % 8 == 7:  # rare condition (1/8 chance)
212	                edges_hit.add(13)  # 6->14 (rare)
213	                edges_hit.add(22)  # 14->15 (rare)
214	                edges_hit.add(23)  # 15->19
215	            else:
216	                edges_hit.add(12)  # 6->13
217	                edges_hit.add(21)  # 13->19
218	        elif current == 7:
219	            edges_hit.add(14)  # 7->15
220	            edges_hit.add(23)  # 15->19
221	        elif current == 8:
222	            # Crash path 1: requires byte[2] in [0x30..0x3F] AND byte[3] in [0x80..0x9F]
223	            if 0x30 <= b2 <= 0x3F and 0x80 <= b3 <= 0x9F:
